items.question: Is RoadReady Driving School a licensed school in Nevada?
items.answer: Yes. The school is licensed by the Nevada DMV under license number PRDS00053720.

items.question: What areas does the school operate?
items.answer: RoadReady serves the entire Las Vegas area, including Summerlin, North Las Vegas, and Henderson.

items.question: What days and hours are driving lessons available?
items.answer: Lessons are available 7 days a week from 10 AM to 7 PM.

items.question: Do I need to come to an office for lessons?
items.answer: No. The instructor comes to you—home, school, or workplace—and returns you after the lesson.

items.question: Who provides the vehicles?
items.answer: Lessons are conducted in school vehicles equipped with dual controls. Free pick‑up and drop‑off are included in every lesson and package.

items.question: Are the vehicles DMV-certified and insured?
items.answer: Yes, all vehicles are fully insured and certified by the DMV.

items.question: Does the instructor have a dual brake pedal?
items.answer: Yes, all vehicles are equipped with instructor‑side brake pedals.

items.question: What screenings do the driving instructors go through?
items.answer: All instructors pass a background check, driving record screening, DMV testing, FBI fingerprinting, and are licensed as certified driving instructors.

items.question: How old do I have to be to start lessons?
items.answer: The minimum age is 15 years and 6 months with a valid learner’s permit.

items.question: What should I bring to the lesson?
items.answer: Bring your learner’s permit or driver’s license, wear comfortable clothing and flat‑soled shoes. Sunglasses are recommended.

items.question: Can I have my phone with me during the lesson?
items.answer: Yes, but it must be on silent mode.

items.question: Can I take a break during the lesson?
items.answer: Absolutely. You can request a stop for a restroom break or to rest at any time.

items.question: What forms of payment are accepted?
items.answer: We accept credit and debit cards. Cash and checks are not accepted.

items.question: Do you offer payment plans?
items.answer: No. All lessons must be paid in advance. Additional lessons can be purchased individually at a proportional rate after completing a package.

items.question: Can I reschedule a lesson?
items.answer: Yes, as long as you notify us at least 24 hours in advance.

items.question: What happens if I’m late?
items.answer: The lesson will still end at the scheduled time, and the missed time won’t be made up.

items.question: What happens if I cancel last minute or don’t show up?
items.answer: If you don’t give at least 24 hours’ notice, the lesson will be considered completed.

items.question: Do you provide a certificate after completing lessons?
items.answer: Yes. A certificate is issued after a minimum of 6 hours of driving and can be used for insurance discounts.

items.question: How soon and where can I schedule a DMV driving test?
items.answer: DMV driving test appointments are typically booked 6–8 weeks in advance. Schedule your test at the Nevada DMV scheduler.

items.question: Can I rent a car for my DMV driving test?
items.answer: Yes, RoadReady offers a car rental with pick‑up and drop‑off service for the day of your driving test.

items.question: Is the instructor present during the DMV test?
items.answer: No. During the actual DMV test, only the examiner and the student are allowed in the vehicle.
